verdicts.reason: A: the RSVP button is shrunk to a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges and sits in a 2x2 grid with them, so the CTA gets lost among them. The centre is cramped: a three-line subhead sits right on top of the date/time block, the time text wraps awkwardly, and the legal mark is a tiny smudge. B: the CTA is a clear, wide orange button with its URL directly under it, and it reads left to right well. But the logo almost touches the 'S' of the headline, the one-line subhead and the time text are tiny, and the red legal box is clipped at the bottom-right edge.
